ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity white pixels to dominant low-intensity black pixels, with white markings occupying approximately 5-8% of the total visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black base with scattered, high-contrast white linear and punctate markings; highest density of white pixels is concentrated on the distal tips and in a specific cluster on the upper-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Broad V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 135 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary; the right lobe exhibits more frequent and deeper jagged peaks/valleys compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave upward sweep from the notch to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, slightly upturned lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast clusters of circular white pixel groups (barnacles) visible on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, unaligned white linear scratches (rake marks) distributed across both lobes, with a high-density intersecting grid pattern on the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive surface scarring across the ventral area; barnacle colonization on the distal margins; minor irregular nicks along the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive cross-hatched or 'X' shaped white scar localized in the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe.
